baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled desire root at words 3 and 11, the noun-verb repetition at words 4-5, the two selective clauses, and the then-sequence into Hell.
baseline_models.mechanism: A human will selects immediacy, but it does not control either content or recipient. A second will selects a thing and a person, accelerates only that intersection inside the immediate field, and then transforms the recipient's condition into exposure to fire, blame, and expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Desire and will supply the two agencies whose apparent lexical sameness masks an asymmetry of control.
Acceleration and presentation before due time supply the temporal operation applied to the desired field.
Will attached to a thing makes the accelerated content chosen rather than coextensive with the seeker's request.
Making as transformation carries the sequence from a granted condition into an assigned terminal condition.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the direct bodily consequence of the transformed condition.
The second mapped inventory independently preserves encountering fire as the consequence, preventing a merely figurative reading.
Blame and fault supply the evaluative exposure accompanying the bodily consequence.
Driving away supplies the final spatial and relational exclusion.

changed_reading.before: Whoever wants worldly life receives it and is later punished.
changed_reading.after: Whoever makes immediacy the object of desire enters a selective acceleration regime: only a divinely chosen content reaches a divinely chosen recipient, and the same sequence ends by assigning that recipient fire, exposed fault, and exclusion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of desire surround the accelerated object and divine choosing, while the acceleration root also carries a short-road image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seeker is not only choosing a temporal domain but repeatedly scouting for a quick route through it. Desire can oscillate, search, and return, while the answer is governed by another will; the ayah therefore diagnoses a restless acquisition posture rather than a single settled preference.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supply an acquisitive search pattern inside the repeated desire construction.
Coming and going without settlement supplies the instability of that search.
The non-dominant mapped root contributes repetition, hesitation, and return, intensifying the doubled will as a feedback loop.
The quick or shortened road gives the restless search a shortcut logic.

changed_reading.before: The subject calmly prefers the present over the future.
changed_reading.after: The subject repeatedly scouts the present for a shortcut and remains unsettled inside desire; the second will in the ayah interrupts any assumption that this search governs its own result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final pair, blamed and driven away, follows an imposed change of condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The blame root can carry covenant, guarantee, protected right, and inviolability as well as censure. Coupled with expulsion, the ending can register not only negative speech but the collapse of protected standing: the recipient is made exposed and then removed.

activation_trace.role: Transformation supplies the shift from apparent beneficiary status to an imposed unprotected status.
Covenant, guarantee, protected right, and scruple about violating them supply the social-juridical underside of being blamed.
Expulsion turns lost standing into actual removal from proximity and protection.

changed_reading.before: The ending adds two synonymous insults after punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ending layers censure with a loss of protected standing: fault is exposed, covenantal shelter is absent, and exclusion is enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier good-to-self and evil-against-self polarity turns the focus ayah's repeated 'for him' into a feedback marker. The accelerated object and Hell are not disconnected allotments; both are placed on the same recipient-facing circuit.

activation_trace.role: Doing good supplies the positive action whose benefit returns to the acting selves.
The self as the very same entity supplies the recipient to whom action returns.
What harms supplies the negative action that returns against that same self.
Transformation links the second 'for him' to the recipient's resulting condition.
Fault and blame disclose the negative value of what has returned to the seeker.

structural_cues: 17:7 states that good is for the selves and evil is against them; 17:18 uses 'for him' both for acceleration and for the making of Hell.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the self-return polarity and the doubled 'for him'; I infer that the repetition marks one consequence circuit. It may alternatively remain distributive grammar without saying that the grant itself contributes to the end.

changed_reading.before: A desired benefit is granted first, and an unrelated punishment is appended later.
changed_reading.after: The desired acceleration and the terminal allotment face the same self; the repeated 'for him' makes the apparent benefit part of a self-returning consequence pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human who calls for harm with the same call used for benefit and is then named hasty supplies an epistemic defect behind the focus desire. Immediate wanting can mistake a harmful object for a good one, so selective divine willing is not merely restriction of quantity but a counter-agency against the seeker's unstable valuation.

activation_trace.role: Invocation of an unwelcome descent supplies the paradox of actively requesting what harms.
Harm and evil supply the misclassified requested object.
Inclination toward what benefits supplies the template with which the harmful request is confused.
Human haste explicitly diagnoses the temporal pressure under which harmful and beneficial objects are conflated.
The opposed occurrences of willing let divine selection interrupt the human valuation.
The focus noun-verb repetition converts the general human haste into the specific desired and administered acceleration.

structural_cues: 17:11 puts harm and benefit into the same prayer frame and closes with human haste; 17:18 opens with desire for the immediate and then limits both what and whom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hasty caller who treats harm like benefit; I infer that the immediate seeker may likewise misvalue the requested object. A deliberate preference for short-term benefit remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The seeker knowingly chooses a lesser temporal good.
changed_reading.after: The seeker may be unable, under haste, to distinguish benefit from harm; the selective clauses expose a conflict not only of timelines but of valuations.

context_deltas.mechanism: An attached record is brought out, opened, read by its own bearer, and made sufficient for reckoning while burden remains non-transferable. This gives the focus blame an evidentiary mechanism: it is a self-verifying assessment attached to the same person, not an arbitrary insult.

activation_trace.role: Binding and attaching by judgment supply the record's non-detachable relation to its bearer.
Written composition supplies the durable evidence that can be presented.
The opened or published writing supplies evidentiary disclosure.
Reading and recitation make the bearer participate in disclosure of the record.
The self as the identical entity supplies the witness-accountant who cannot be displaced.
Counting and reckoning supply the evaluative procedure behind the later blame.
A heavy burden supplies non-transferable personal consequence.
Blame and fault become the verdict made legible by the attached accounting sequence.

structural_cues: 17:13-15 proceeds from attachment at the neck to an opened book, self-reading, sufficient self-accounting, and non-transferable burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an evidentiary sequence immediately before the focus; I infer that 'blamed' names its disclosed assessment. Blame could still denote social or divine censure without invoking the record mechanism directly.

changed_reading.before: Blame is a separate humiliating label added to fire.
changed_reading.after: Blame is the inspectable verdict of a record attached to, opened before, and read by the same recipient whose burden cannot be transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent town sequence places divine will, affluent release, outward rupture, a consequence becoming due, and destruction on one chain. It activates the possibility that an accelerated present allotment is not a reward later cancelled but an enabling exposure through which a recipient's trajectory exits its covering and becomes due for judgment.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing initiates the adjacent destruction sequence and echoes the selecting will in the focus.
Expansive ease that releases its possessor supplies abundance as an enabling condition rather than a verdict of approval.
A ripe date exiting its covering supplies the material image of an inward trajectory becoming outwardly manifest.
A fixed due claim supplies the transition from manifested conduct to unavoidable consequence.
Extirpating destruction supplies the endpoint of the adjacent causal sequence.
Sin and culpability prevent the historical destruction sequence from reading as blind material collapse.
Knowledge of the report and inward reality supplies discriminating awareness behind the sequence.
Acceleration supplies the focus operation that can function as exposure rather than uncomplicated favor.

structural_cues: 17:16 orders will, a town, its affluent people, their rupture, the consequence becoming due, and destruction; 17:17 adds informed awareness of servants' sins before 17:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered town sequence; I infer an analogy in which accelerated allotment can enable disclosure and consequence. The alternative is that 17:16 and 17:18 are parallel judgments with no claim that the focus grant helps produce the end.

changed_reading.before: Present granting is a genuine reward that is simply followed by a separate penalty.
changed_reading.after: Present acceleration can itself be probationary exposure: released abundance lets a trajectory emerge, become due, and terminate in the condition assigned by the focus ayah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate-directed desire is paired with a later-directed desire that must be embodied in fitting movement and faith. Both groups nevertheless receive connected extension from an unrestricted gift, while the later field has larger graded differentiation. Present receipt therefore cannot by itself certify approval, and later-directed desire is not bare postponement but desire matched by sustained action.

activation_trace.role: Desire and intention repeat the focus agency while changing its object to the later field.
Deferral to a later time supplies the explicit temporal counter-object to immediacy.
Purposeful movement toward an object makes later-directed desire an enacted trajectory rather than a wish.
Recognition of gift supplies acknowledgment of the effort rather than mere possession of its object.
Connected increase that supports another supplies ongoing extension to both groups.
Giving and handing over supply the common source of what both groups presently receive.
Absence of prohibition prevents present gift from being restricted to the approved trajectory.
Degree and distinction supply comparison within both present and later fields.
Stepwise gradation supplies a scale larger than the binary possession or deprivation imagined by haste.
Acceleration supplies the near-term operation now relativized by common extension and larger later grades.

structural_cues: 17:18 and 17:19 are parallel desire constructions, but 17:19 adds effort proportioned to its object and faith; 17:20 extends both groups; 17:21 compares present distinctions with greater later grades.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel pair, matched effort, common extension, and larger later grades; I infer that present receipt is not an approval signal. The exact scope and shape of the two groups' present extension remain unspecified.

changed_reading.before: One group gets the present while the other forgoes it in exchange for the future.
changed_reading.after: Both trajectories can receive present extension; their difference lies in what organizes desire, whether desire becomes fitting effort and trust, and the greater graded field in which that effort is acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition against delegating protection to another and the closing prohibition against making another deity frame a failed dependency mechanism. Making a surrogate object of reliance ends in blamed immobility and isolation; this activates the focus ending as the collapse of borrowed protection, not only penal relocation.

activation_trace.role: Handing one's affair to another supplies the delegated-dependence mechanism prohibited near the opening.
Making something into a status supplies the act that installs a surrogate object of allegiance.
Worship and the worshipped object specify the surrogate relation.
Being made unable to rise supplies the failed agency produced by that relation.
The repeated blame root contributes failed protection and violated standing at the frame's close.
Separation from one's group supplies abandonment and isolation as the result of surrogate reliance.
The focus blame receives the same protected-standing nuance activated by the repeated wording in 17:22.
Expulsion realizes the isolation latent in abandonment.

structural_cues: 17:2 prohibits taking a guardian besides God; 17:22 prohibits making another deity and ends with the same 'blamed' as 17:18 followed by abandonment rather than expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the framing prohibitions and repeated blame formula; I infer that misplaced delegation explains loss of protection in the focus. The immediate seeker is not explicitly called an idolater, so this is a relational analogy rather than an identity claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus subject is expelled solely because of temporal preference.
changed_reading.after: The ending can also diagnose failed dependency: treating an immediate object as organizing reliance leaves the seeker without protected standing and finally isolated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes a normally temporal contrast. It remains anchored in the focus acceleration root's explicit short-road branch and in the packet's night journey to the farthest boundary for disclosed signs. Downstream prose should present it as a route analogy, not replace 'the immediate' with 'the short road.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun-verb pair from the acceleration root at words 4-5, especially its quick-road or shortcut branch.

activation_trace.role: Night travel supplies a guided movement whose value is not immediate visibility.
Distance and the farthest boundary supply the route opposed to shortcut logic.
Showing and making visible supply the disclosure reached through the far journey.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes deliberation, opposing reflexive shortcut selection.
A manifest sign supplies what the longer guided route is ordered to disclose.
The quick or shortened road supplies the focus-side route image.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts only present time with later time.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary spatial image, it contrasts shortcut acquisition with a guided journey willing to cross darkness and distance in order to receive signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the trap branches of the burning root are form-distant from the direct fire sense. It remains valid as a spatial overlay because 17:8 explicitly makes Hell an enclosing or confining place. Downstream prose must retain literal encounter with fire and qualify trap as the geometry of that encounter, not an alternative translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb of encountering Hell at word 16, whose split inventories preserve both direct fire and set-trap branches.

activation_trace.role: Confinement, prevention, and enclosure supply the spatial character of Hell in the nearby occurrence.
Making into a condition supplies the exact nearby construction that links Hell with enclosure.
Encountering fire preserves the direct surface consequence.
The second mapped inventory independently confirms fire and heat as primary.
Set snares and traps supply the secondary capture geometry.
The non-dominant mapped inventory also preserves the set-trap image, supporting rather than replacing the direct fire sense.

changed_reading.before: The subject reaches a place where fire inflicts pain.
changed_reading.after: The subject encounters fire inside a condition whose nearby and branch-activated geometry is enclosure: the accelerated route terminates not only in heat but in capture without an exit.

strongest_changes: The doubled 'for him' becomes a self-return circuit when read through 17:7, joining accelerated allotment and terminal allotment rather than leaving them as unrelated stages.
17:11 recasts immediate desire as hasty misclassification of harm as benefit, making divine selection a counter-agency to unstable human valuation.
17:13-15 gives 'blamed' an attached, self-read, non-transferable evidentiary mechanism.
17:16-17 permits accelerated abundance to function as exposure rather than uncomplicated favor.
17:19-21 shows that both trajectories receive present extension while later-directed desire is distinguished by fitting effort, trust, acknowledgment, and larger grades.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is built from doubled will, doubled acceleration, repeated recipient marking, and a then-sequence from selected provision to transformed status. The context repeatedly converts those compact doublings into mechanisms of self-return, misvaluation, disclosure, exposure, differentiated effort, and failed protection without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The affluence sequence in 17:16 may be a causal analogue for accelerated provision or only an adjacent parallel judgment.
The covenantal nuance of the blame root and the trap nuance of the fire root are branch-backed but should remain qualified overlays.
The packet does not resolve whether the selective clauses primarily describe withholding, differential pacing, differential recipients, or all three.
